Existentials reuse current resource/state values; query facts follow from predicate unfolding and the existing query-length lemma; write resources are split/reassembled with existing array/list lemmas; successful returns use the existing physical-write and logical-state transition lemmas. No witness requires a generated-file, statement, or seed-spec change.
